limits: A diagnostic texture provider supplies the owned texture. Production authored-bundle loading is outside this fixture.
An inert component exercises the production observer through its internal fixture seam. No original game script is instantiated.
Exact production component type and fields are supported by local assembly inspection and game-reference compilation, not a played-world test.
Repeated oversized component nodes keep a census incomplete and may retain unseen leases indefinitely until a complete pass or shutdown. The 1024-material bound limits growth, not eviction latency.
No original-shader draw, visual approval, game deployment, biome approval or target-hardware performance result is granted by this fixture.
